dex.text: A small round of cheese that has taken against the hill it was born on and means to get to the bottom of it. It rolls when it is cross, which is nearly always, and it smells wonderful while it does.
dex.fact: Double Gloucester is made from full-cream milk, pressed into big wheels, turned daily and matured for months. Its warm orange colour traditionally comes from annatto, a seed, and a wheel is rolled down Cooper's Hill near Gloucester each spring bank holiday.

dex.text: Two wheels stacked and a face like someone who has been rolled down a hill forty times and enjoyed every one. It never actually wins the race. It just arrives, shortly after the cheese, with the look of a champion.
dex.fact: The Cooper's Hill cheese-rolling has been held for at least two hundred years. A wheel of Double Gloucester of about three to four kilograms is sent down a slope as steep as one in two, and the first person to reach the bottom wins it.
